No.55/1/1/95-Cab
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (BHARAT SARKAR)
CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVALAYA)

The undersigned is directed to say that with effect from the
19th September, 1995 -

(i) Shri Eduardo Faleiro, Minister of State in the Ministry
of Chemicals and Fertilisers, Minister of State in the
Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs and Minister of State
in the Departments of Electronics and Ocean
Development, relinquished the additional charge of the
office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of
Parliamentary Affairs.

(ii) Smt. Krishna Sahi relinquished the office of the
Minister of State in the Ministry of Civil Supplies,
Consumer Affairs and Public Distribution and assumed
the office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of
Civil Supplies, Consumer Affairs and Public
Distribution (Department of Civil Supplies).

(iii) Shri Mallikarjun, Minister of State in the Ministry of
Defence, Minister of State in the Ministry of
Parliamentary Affairs and Minister of State in the
Ministry of Railways, relinquished the office of the
Minister of State in the Ministry of Defence and the
additional charge of the office of the Minister of
State in the Ministry of Railways and assumed the
office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of
Defence (Department of Defence). He will continue to
hold the charge of the office of the Minister of State
in the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs.

(iv) Shri S.S. Ahluwalia, Minister of State in the Ministry
of Urban Affairs and Employment (Department of Urban
Employment and Poverty Alleviation), assumed the charge
of the office, also, of the Minister of State in the
Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs.

(v) Shri Venod Sharma relinquished the office of the
Minister of State in the Ministry of Civil Supplies,
Consumer Affairs and Public Distribution and assumed
the office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of
Civil Supplies, Consumer Affairs and Public
Distribution (Department of Consumer Affairs and Public
Distribution System).
All Members of the Council of Ministers.
